Lacroa Castle
This castle is the seat of King Revil, who rules over the Lacroa Kingdom.
It overlooks a large and bustling castle town where people live in peace.
That peace was shattered the day the star fell.

Loum Village
A village located near Lacroa Castle.
Although the village itself is fairly tranquil, ferocious monsters prowl the lands to the south.
Care must be taken during any excursions.

Stone Tablet Cave
A cave where an ancient stone tablet is said to be sealed away.
The cave is inhabited by many slimes—
some even claim to have seen one carrying the stone tablet.

Palta Port Town
A town that thrives on fishing and trade.
Boats bound for Luna II depart regularly.
There has been increased pirate activity lately, so those who decide to take to the sea must be well prepared.

Luna II Town
A port town that trades with Palta.
Thieves and pirates have been increasingly active lately,
making life difficult for the traders.

Thieves' Village
A hidden village under the control of a band of thieves known as the Black Tri-Stars. Practically lawless.
The only way to enter it is to be captured or find one of the secret paths.

Mahal Village
A village located at the eastern edge of the Saddrac World.

Fon Town
It is said that a weapon shop in this town holds the Staff of Ice, a mysterious staff that can make the sea itself freeze over.

Ra Cailum Town
Perhaps due to its proximity to Satan Gundam Castle, monsters appear frequently in this town, making it quite dangerous.
The bridge connecting the town to the mainland is broken, hence it can only be reached by sea.

Granada Tower
The tower that maintains the barrier around Satan Gundam Castle.
Its interior is like a labyrinth—impossible to navigate without a map.

Satan Gundam Castle
The Satan Gundam appeared suddenly in the Saddrac World along with the falling star.
It has made this ancient castle its base.
The place is heavily guarded.

Sweetwater Town
A peaceful town known for its pure water.
Situated in the middle of a lake, it can only be reached by boat.

Green Oasis Town
A beautiful town where life is easy.
A great desert expands to the south.

Pergamino Palace
This was once a peaceful town,
but after the betrayal by Cleric M'Quve Katze, the king was imprisoned
and the nation rapidly overtaken by a cult worshipping the giant.

Fairy Forest
An island in the sea east of Pergamino, inhabited solely by fairies.
The winged fairy Kikka lives on this island.

Pit of Summoning
A wise elder who possesses the Call spell tome lives here.
This spell can be used to give a Carddass physical form and have it fight by your side.

Stone Castle
An enormous ruin in the middle of a desert.
Any who wish to enter or leave must brave the constant sandstorms that surround it.
M'Quve Katze, who plans to resurrect the giant, has made it his base of operations.

Dark Abyss
A labyrinth said to contain  the Recall spell tome.
This spell banishes creatures summoned by enemies.

Hut
Knight Amuro stumbled across this hut during his training journey.
Brothers who fled the war in Munzo live here in seclusion.

Castle Munzo
King Conscon rules over the Munzo Empire from this castle.
This was once a peaceful nation, but somewhere in the past, conflict sparked and turned into all-out war with Algas.
Princess Yuiry is determined to put an end to the fighting.

Texas Town
An abandoned town, where nothing remains.

Cave of Guidance
A cave system that connects to the Kingdom of Algas.

Algas Castle
The castle wherefrom King Blex rules over the Kingdom of Algas.
The nation is at war with the Munzo Empire.
Its cavalry, warriors, and mages form the outstanding force known as the Algas Knights.
However, since the capture of their leader, Knight Alex, by the Munzo Empire,
the knights have been in disarray, their organization in danger of collapse.

Jupitris Tower
This tower is infested with formidable monsters and littered with traps.
Some rooms require a secret password to enter.
